entities.name: Marie de Jésus Deluil-Martiny
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marie Deluil-Martiny, known in religion as Marie of Jesus, was a French Catholic religious sister and the founder of the Daughters of the Heart of Jesus. She was murdered by the convent's gardener in 1884. She was beatified by Pope John Paul II in 1989.
